source.name: Graph Auto Reader original compact chart-preserving x2 candidate

outputs.name: enhanced
outputs.inverse_coordinate_mapping: original_x = enhanced_x / 2 and original_y = enhanced_y / 2, followed by the recorded earlier inverse transforms

preprocessing.source: immutable original or explicitly transformed panel crop
preprocessing.channel_handling: decode locally, convert to RGB, preserve a separate reversible transform record
preprocessing.tensor_conversion: HWC to NCHW float32 with a batch dimension
preprocessing.normalization: divide uint8 samples by 255 and require finite values in [0,1]
preprocessing.training_data: deterministic procedural Graph Auto Reader scenes only
preprocessing.original_preservation: the source image is immutable and may not be overwritten
preprocessing.architecture: graphsr-srvgg-x2-v1 with 24 channels, four residual blocks, bilinear x2 geometry anchor, and PixelShuffle correction
preprocessing.artifact_sha256_status: exact SHA-256 of the deterministic ignored 100-step public-synthetic candidate; the held-out fidelity gate failed and release is prohibited
preprocessing.source_revision_status: bind to the final tracked source commit before release review

postprocessing.tensor_processing: require finite NCHW output, clamp to [0,1], and convert to the caller's derived-image encoding
postprocessing.output_dimension_validation: require output width and height to equal exactly twice the input dimensions
postprocessing.public_coordinate_mapping: map enhanced detections back through inverse scale 0.5 and all recorded earlier inverse transforms
postprocessing.original_preservation: write a derived image only; never replace the immutable source
postprocessing.disagreement_policy: reduce confidence and require review when original and enhanced evidence disagree materially

benchmarks.training_scope: attempt 2 of 3; 100 optimizer steps on 16 deterministic public-synthetic crops from four training-family scenes using repaired per-marker loss; held-out scenes were opened only after training
benchmarks.quality_claims: numerical parity only; held-out fidelity acceptance failed

benchmarks.provider_status: cpu benchmark passed; directml and cuda not verified
benchmarks.quality_claims: GraphSR failed marker-center, thin-line, and open-marker thresholds and is not eligible for selection

measurement_contract.runtime: input decode through output RGB uint8 materialization; common shape validation and metric scoring excluded
measurement_contract.memory: maximum combined resident working set of the benchmark host and candidate child processes sampled every 1 ms over the runtime boundary

benchmarks.selection_policy: select no default unless all five candidates are measured, all absolute downstream gates pass, no downstream metric regresses against bicubic, and the selected candidate improves both actual numeric OCR exact match and marker-center F1; the image-only OCR proxy cannot satisfy the OCR gate
blockers: official candidate runtimes are not approved or locally configured
actual numeric OCR, marker detector, and shape/fill classifier adapters are unavailable
DirectML and CUDA providers have not been verified
source revision is not bound to a tracked commit
reviewed release storage and package parity have not been verified
